column1: # Protein sets for the Pfam-A annotation benchmark (dev/bench/uniprot.py, dev/perf/annot.tsv).
# Each set: 1,000 UniProtKB/Swiss-Prot proteins drawn from the query below, then split by length
# into 4 groups of 250 (the set's own quartiles). Every query gets "AND reviewed:true AND
# fragment:false" appended. Sets are drawn in this order; a protein already drawn by an earlier
# set is skipped, so no protein is in two sets.
virus       taxonomy_id:10239 AND virus_host_id:2759 AND NOT virus_host_id:2
